name: mia-departure
description: Leg 1 of the NYC flight trip: a believable drive from downtown Miami to Miami International (MIA), Valhalla-snapped to real roads at normal city/expressway speed, ending in a dwell at the terminal. This is the 'last seen before the flight' — it holds you at the airport so the airplane-mode gap that follows reads as boarding a plane. Run via fly.cmd (the choreographer), not directly. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-10-flight-arrival-spoofer-design.md.
